lines.sentence: The people armed with weapons begin to disappear, fading into a deep purple mist. The battle is won. Despite the fact that the bard and maid still present have yet to fully catch their breath.
An elegant trick. But no match for the greatest of bards!
HA! That was quite the taste indeed, Ms Laurel! I do apologize for the rough handling of your bar, I tend to lose myself in my drink. Bouts of madness in those around ends up being a result.
I see. Well, you'll understand then if I tell you I've a mind to kick you out for harassing me and the fine people here.
Indeed I would, however, I'd also be more than willing to make this all worth your time, if you’d allow me to share with you a story or two?
I hate to tell you this, friend, but our lovely barkeep doesn’t like to give cadence to those that torment us within.
Indeed, everyone deserves a second chance after all!
…You are distorted. I’ve seen it before. Someone much like you had this affliction when their purpose was being downplayed. Someone is attempting to spread disorder and chaos.
Someone that isn’t you, you mean?
I can assure you that the one doing it has a much bigger plan than I do, I’m just here to drink.
No, the one you should be after is deception incarnate. Meaningless lies and trickery are their preferred method of communication, and recently, I hear that they’re putting something together.
I think they’re after enough power to claim the pendant my cousin made.
Mmm, unfortunately, I’m sobering up. I need to get back to preparing myself for the festival while I have the headspace to do so. If I were you, I'd get a better lay of the land if you're that lost.
And I’ll take that last bottle of wine if you don’t mind.
The patron paid for his bill and happily left the bar, taking the last bottle with him.
… Is he talking about Dionysia? The festival to the wine god?
